# Abu Dhabi Registration Authority (ADRA)

> ADRA is Abu Dhabi's central business registration and licensing authority, providing comprehensive services for business setup, compliance, and consumer protection in the emirate.

ADRA serves as the primary regulatory body for business registration and licensing in Abu Dhabi, operating under the framework of Federal Law No. (15) of 2020. The authority facilitates business establishment, maintains legal compliance standards, and protects consumer rights across the emirate's diverse economy.
